name: Geo Distance
description: Adds the haversine distance between two coordinate pairs to the table. Coordinates are latitude/longitude columns in decimal degrees; the distance is computed in SQL in kilometres or miles with the mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km, and the original columns are kept. Both coordinate pairs are required.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Latitude column of the first point (decimal degrees).

lng.title: Longitude
lng.description: Longitude column of the first point (decimal degrees).

lat2.title: Latitude 2
lat2.description: Latitude column of the second point (decimal degrees).

lng2.title: Longitude 2
lng2.description: Longitude column of the second point (decimal degrees).
